strings.en: You're not getting in my way!
I can't afford to hold back!
I've got the rhythm!/　From 8-beat to 16-beat!
I may not look it, but/　I've been through my share of hell!
In fights like this,/　whoever strikes first wins!
Waiting around just isn't my style!
My opponent is... gonna be that one!
I'm going all out, one after another!
Once I lock onto a target or a crush,/　they don't get away!
Let's settle this with this one!
I'll show you the Boxer's footwork!
This Gespenst has a really nice response!
I won't let you lay a hand on that unit!
You're So-Des, right? So yes, you are!
You're hyped up in all the wrong ways, you know!
Jua-Mu, you're gonna deal with me too!
I know how it feels to lose someone precious, but...!
I won't let you lay a hand on Touya and the others!
Fu-Ruu of the Fury.../　...is such a mouthful!
You sure look like a bad guy!
I can't forgive someone like you, Gu-Landon!
I'm gonna make you take a huge loss!
That type's always nasty deep down.
Iradoya! I'll settle things with you here!
Another guy with a weird name...!
I came to pay you back, Gadisword!
I'm getting through to the Rabulpaila, Vort!
Youth versus you! Here I come, Reggiane!
The Cross Gate isn't your stage!
Debudedabide? What kind of magic spell is that?!
No thank you to your magic show!
If nobody's aboard, I'm going all out!
I won't lose to some Madnet!
My charms will turn you to jelly, bones and all!
Your name is exactly what you look like!
Like I'd hand our future over to you!
Your way of thinking is totally messed up, XN-L!
Now that's a textbook final boss!
XN-L, nobody asked you to show up!
I'm sick of seeing your faces!
I'll chase you out of the Earth Sphere/　as many times as it takes!
Like I'd let you turn a profit!
You lackeys of the war merchants!
All right, time for some headhunting!
Even if I aim sloppily, I'll hit that thing!
New face or not, I won't lose!
Show me what the new model can do!
I won't let the Fury do as they please!
Even if you're way over Thorn!
I won't let you do as you please, Gadisword!
Cuppid, Cupit? Here comes Cupid.../　Ugh, that's so confusing!
I'll hold off the Gadisword guys!
So the big rookie has made an entrance?!
Things like that don't bother me!
Okay, time to go monster hunting!
Fighting monsters gets my blood pumping,/　for some reason!
I may not look it, but I'm great at monster hunting!
Lamaris, caught you... Wait, I shouldn't, huh?
One after another.../　Seriously, there's no end to them!
That Kaana codename is so confusing!
Even if the Lamaris Combine,/　that won't make them invincible, no way!
So you got bigger. So what?!
I'm not the one you're supposed to be fighting...!
Time for you to get off that stage!
Creepy-cute is totally in my range!
Even a Chinese monster/　doesn't scare me!
Look away and you'll get hurt!!
Don't get too full of yourself!
I'm paying you back for every hit!
Thanks for the approach./　But my answer's no thank you!
Okay, time to switch sides! Here I come!
I'm good at counters too, you know!
It's too early to go home!
Sorry, Yuu! I'm heading back first!
Whoa! This is getting really bad!!
Ngh...!/　Guess I'll have to go for a comeback!
Ugh!/　Pulling through at the last second is my motto!
I-I'll have the last laugh! I won't give up!
Gunner, let's hang in there till the very end!
I-I'm tougher than I look, you know!!
L-Looks like this stage favors them...!
I've got no choice but to go for a giant killing!
Kh, at this rate, the Lamaris Kaana will...!
That thing's way beyond a Kaana!
Whoa! Did I mess up again!?
Yuu!/　I'm fine over here, so don't worry!
Don't mind, Gunner! We'll make a comeback from here!
H-Huh? That's not what the data said...?!
Ugh... Guess that's a new model for you...?!
Ugh, I can't believe you'd use such a Thorny attack...!
Whoa! It's no good if I'm the one getting hunted!
So you're not just some small-fry monster!?
This is no time to call it creepy-cute!
H-Hey! What was that attack just now?!
K-Keep the jokes to your looks!
I can't believe I took a hit from a Lamaris!
It's not just the looks.../　It fights like a monster too...!
The Ares Geist data doesn't work anymore?!
Gu-Landon! It's too early to play king!
S-So you're not the boss/　for nothing...!!
If I just Vort-er around in a daze,/　I can't stop him...?!
Is this what they call the wisdom of age?!
I've gotta do something about her backup dancers...!
Y-You can keep the jokes to your face!
I can't catch the Crystal Dragoon's rhythm?!
Whoa! Did I just pull a bonehead move?!
Kh! Whatever's inside,/　I can't afford to lose!
Guess I missed a step there?
That barely counts as a hit!
Losing heart means losing out! I'm still fine!
I've got extra armor on!/　This is nothing!
Is that all you've got, Jua-Mu?!
Ow, ow... A thorn got stuck in me.
Don't get cocky over something like this,/　Gu-Landon!
You don't need to go easy on me, Vort!
Ugh, but I won't lose on youth!
The Cross Gate isn't your toy!
I'm not one to go down quietly to you guys!
Go do that magic at a circus!
I can handle that thing's attacks!
Glad it took the bait, but...
The Fury aren't so tough after all!
Don't get full of yourself just because you Combined!
That thing's moving better than before!
Too slow! You're not riding the beat!
Dodging and dancing are all about rhythm!
Aha! Luck's on my side today!
I saw that coming a mile away!
So? How do you like my dancing?
I won't let you touch me that easily!
In top form, in top form!
I'm not wearing this Booster/　just for show!
Even the Gunner can nail a turn!
I knew you'd come that way, Karo-Ran!
Like I'd let that guy become king!
Iradoya, you can't throw off my rhythm!
Aren't you approaching the wrong person?
It's pointless if you can't hit, Herluga!
Hey, shouldn't you go on a diet?
You've got four eyes and you still can't hit me?
XN-L, things won't go the way you want!
My body remembers that unit's rhythm!
Like I'd get hit by an alien's attack!
Hurry up and go back to your own planet!
I won't get caught up in the Leader unit's pace!
That's it, keep aiming at me.
I won't let the Fury catch my rhythm!
I'm used to dealing with monsters!
I've got no intention of dancing with a ghost!
Ida? More like Ida-n't care! Bleh~!
Its rhythm is different from Ares Geist, but...!
Isn't that approach a little pushy?
Just what I'd expect from the big boss./　What an attack.
It's creepy-cute, but I don't want it in my collection~
Huh, it's not as scary as it looks.
Like I'd get beaten by a monster!
Whoa, didn't see that attack coming.
It's like a traveling circus of wonders!
Heh, I've got gear like this too.
I can't just take/　every hit, you know!
Come on, off you go! Shoo!
Aiming at me won't do you any good!
Out of ammo now, of all times?/　You've gotta be kidding me!
Geez! Now I have to start all over again!
OK, OK! Leave the backup chorus to me!
Looks like it's my time to shine!
When it rains, it pours!/　And here comes Carla!
Okay, now the real show begins!
Looks like a solo, but it's a duet!
Yuu! Leave the rest to me!
Way to go, Yuu! I'm right behind you!
Yuu, I'm keeping right up with you!
Kusuha, leave the rest to me!
Rio, thanks for the big moment!
Tasuku, I'll...!/　Hey, you're not even listening!
You can count on me, Ryoto!
Major Sänger, I'm lending a hand!
Princess, don't push yourself too hard!
Kota, leave the rest to me!
Ing, leave the rest to me!
Right then, we're comin' at ya too!
Leave the rest to me, Calvina!
Akemi, leave the rest to me!
Thought it'd be over that ea~sy?
Worship your big sister, Deadpan Boobs.
Mind if I spill all your secrets? Red Seaweed.
Mind if I tug on them from both sides?/　Those black panties.
Is that all this Bang-Bang Kaiser can do?
I'm just not the type/　to keep quiet at times like this!
Let me show you how big my heart is!
You can't just attack all the time!
Don't you dare call this meddling!
Yuu!/　I'll take the hit for you!
I won't let them get Yuu!
Rio, get out of here, quick!
Leona, don't let your guard down!
Bullet, get out of there, quick!
Ryoto, leave this one to me!
Major Sänger,/　I'll take care of that one!
I said fall back already, didn't I!
Come on, come on!/　You're a sitting duck in that spot!
I'll take you all at once!!
This is the time for a map weapon!!
Two barrels this time! Double the power!!
Let me show you my graceful footwork!
Did you know? Stag beetles are/　way stronger than rhino beetles!
And to wrap it up in style...
Shooting and dancing share the same rhythm!
This rhythm's more samba than waltz...
Let's go, Jigan!/　Your fists pack a million volts!!
I'll give you a shock right to the heart!!
This one's my ace in the hole!/　Here, take it!!
Gonna hit you hard! Really hard!!
Once I whip it out, it's amazing!!
Take that, and that, and that!
Up Rock! A raging six-hit combo!
This time I'm getting super serious!
Bet that made you sick... six, get it?
Okay, let's fire it off with a bang!
And to finish, I'll launch myself too!
Let us show you/　our dazzling steps!
If it misses,/　it'll cost me in more ways than one!
To be honest, I'm not really sure/　where or how it fires from...
But I know it's a finishing blow!
No need for a ten count!
I'm a Boxer, but I fight with my gorgeous legs!
Let me escort you to a front-row seat!
Aw, fine, take it all, you thief!
Shooting and dancing have the same knack!
And here comes the star of the show!
Now then, a showdown with my ace in the hole!
Code DTD activated~ Leave it to me!
Hey, should we go all the way/　to a wardrobe malfunction?
Take that, and that, and that!!
In love and in battle, you've gotta push!
And one more push to seal it!
I'll show you what I've really got, Harga!
Take that, and that, and that, and that!
